summary: Classify development directory segments in the Dropbox index and keep cleanup plans out of them by default, with explicit opt-in and an apply gate.
reason: Real Dropbox data has most duplicate candidates inside dependency and tooling folders; soft-deleting those files or empty internal folders can break code projects.
validated_outcome: Fixture tests cover migration, filtering, reports, plan refusal, and a 250,000-file read scale case.
